facts.value: NO. As of 07.11.2026 there is no Notice of Examination for a 2026 Head Constable (AWO/TPO) in Delhi Police examination on ssc.gov.in.

NO. Neither examination appears in the SSC examination calendar: the calendar API returns 13 records for 2026 and none of them is a Head Constable (Ministerial) or Head Constable (AWO/TPO) examination.
18 to 27 years as on 01.07.2025 (candidates born not before 02.07.1998 and not later than 01.07.2007).

SC/ST 5 years; OBC 3 years; Ex-Servicemen 3 years after deduction of military service rendered (as on the closing date); sportspersons of distinction 5 years (10 years for SC/ST); Delhi Police departmental candidates up to 40 (UR), 43 (OBC) and 45 (SC/ST) years; widows/ divorced/ judicially separated women who have not re-married up to 35 (UR/EWS), 38 (OBC) and 40 (SC/ST) years.

10+2 (Senior Secondary) passed from a recognised Board with Science & Mathematics as subjects, OR a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the trade of Mechanic-cum-Operator Electronic Communication System. Professional attainments (qualifying): proficiency in computer operation — English word processing speed of 1000 key depressions in 15 minutes, and basic computer functions (opening/ closing of PC, printing, MS Office usage, saving & modification in typed text, paragraph setting & numbering, etc.).

INR 100 (Rupees One Hundred only); women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST and eligible Ex-Servicemen are exempted; online payment only (BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa/ Master/ Maestro or RuPay debit card); non-refundable and non-adjustable.

Four compulsory stages in order: (i) Computer Based Examination by SSC — 100 marks; (ii) PE&MT by the Delhi Police — qualifying; (iii) Trade Test by the Delhi Police — qualifying; (iv) Test of English Word Processing and Test of Basic Computer Functions (Proficiency in Computer Operation) by the Delhi Police — qualifying. The final merit list is prepared strictly on the basis of the CBE (100 marks) plus incentive/ bonus marks/ weightage, if any. A 15% Reserve Panel is also prepared.

label.hi: अर्हक अंक और शॉर्टलिस्टिंग (CBE) (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: Minimum qualifying marks in the CBE (without NCC bonus): UR/ EWS 40%; SC/ ST/ OBC 35%; Ex-Servicemen 30%. Candidates are called for PE&MT up to 20 times the number of vacancies in each category. In the declared result the Commission lowered the minimum to 30% for EWS and 20% for SC/ ST/ OBC and ESM categories where the requisite number of candidates was not available.

label.hi: बोनस अंक और टाई-ब्रेक (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: NCC 'C' 5%, 'B' 3%, 'A' 2% of the maximum marks (not for Ex-servicemen); Rashtriya Raksha University degree/ PG diploma — Distinction 5%, First Class 4%, Second Class 3%, Pass Class 2%; both granted only on production of original certificates at the PE&MT stage. Tie-break: older candidate → (if date of birth and CBE marks are also the same) alphabetical order of first names.

Male: height 170 cm; chest 81–85 cm with a minimum 4 cm expansion. Female: height 157 cm. Relaxable by 5 cm for residents of hill areas (Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Gorkhas, Dogras, Marathas and candidates belonging to Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya, Assam, Himachal Pradesh, Kashmir and Leh & Ladakh regions of J&K) and for sons/ daughters of serving, retired or deceased Delhi Police personnel/ Multi-Tasking Staff.
Sound health, free from disease, defect or deformity; better eye 6/6 without glasses, worse eye 6/36 corrected with glasses to 6/9 or 6/12 without glasses (both eyes), and free from colour blindness.

label.hi: ट्रेड टेस्ट (पठन और डिक्टेशन) (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: Compulsory and qualifying for candidates who qualify PE&MT; those who do not appear or do not pass stand disqualified. Dictation is given in groups in both Hindi and English — more than 50% mistakes in Hindi or English dictation disqualifies the candidate; the reading test requires reading a passage in both Hindi and English and is videographed. An Appellate Board considers appeals against the Trade Test.

label.en: Test of proficiency in computer operation (2025 notice)
label.hi: कंप्यूटर संचालन दक्षता परीक्षण (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: Qualifying, for candidates who pass the Trade Test. (i) English word processing speed — 1000 key depressions in 15 minutes, on a printed English passage of 200 words entered in MS Word; 1 word is deducted for each mistake and a candidate making 25 mistakes or more is disqualified. (ii) Test of Basic Computer Functions — 5 minutes each for MS-Word, MS-PowerPoint and MS-Excel with 10 listed formatting features per test at half a mark each (5 marks per test); at least 3 marks in each test are required to qualify; editing tools may be used.
